# Review and improve the 100-sound recipe book — Intake Brief

**Work Item:** TF-0MV290BG8003GXXH | **Type:** docs | **Priority:** Medium

> **Headline:** Review the existing `docs/recipe-book/` (index + 100 recipe pages +
> 10 capstone pages), fix its broken links and invalid CLI commands at the
> generator source, and add a "Working with the CLI" section to the index that
> shows how to **find**, **evaluate** and **understand how these sounds were
> created** — backed by tests that keep the book honest.

## Problem statement

The casual-game recipe book already exists (`docs/recipe-book/`), but it has
never been reviewed end-to-end and contains correctness defects and a content
gap: 121 broken relative links, an invalid `toneforge show` command repeated on
all 100 recipe pages, tests that only check for marker presence rather than
block freshness or link validity, and no CLI-workflow guidance in the index. As
a result a reader cannot reliably move from "I want a sound" to finding,
auditioning and understanding it using the documented commands.

## Users

- **Game developers** prototyping casual/arcade games who need to discover and
  audition the 100-sound library from the CLI.
- **Sound designers / technical artists** reading each recipe page to understand
  how a sound was built and how to vary it.
- **ToneForge maintainers** who need the book to stay mechanically in sync with
  the recipes and generators.

Example user stories:

- As a developer, I want a single page that tells me how to find a sound by
  keyword/category/tag and audition it, so I do not have to piece commands
  together from several demos.
- As a sound designer, I want the CLI commands on a recipe page to actually run,
  so I can trust the book as a reference.
- As a maintainer, I want the test suite to fail when a link breaks or a CLI
  block goes stale, so the book cannot silently drift.

## Acceptance Criteria

- All local relative links in `docs/recipe-book/` resolve: a link-integrity check (new or extended) passes for `index.md`, `_template.md`, all 100 recipe pages and all 10 capstone pages, with zero broken local targets.
- Every CLI command shown in the book is valid: `toneforge show --recipe <name>` is replaced by the correct positional form (`toneforge show <name>`) on all 100 recipe pages, and the generators that emit it are corrected so a regeneration produces the same, valid output (second run byte-identical).
- `docs/recipe-book/index.md` gains a **Working with the CLI** section covering **find** (`list recipes` with `--search`/`--category`/`--tags`/`--json`, `show`, `library list`/`library search`), **evaluate** (`generate`, `play`, `analyze`, `classify`, `explore`, `visualize`, `tui`) and **understand how they were created** (`show`, the page's `## Sound design` section, `presets/recipes/*.yaml`, the ToneGraph schema/node-kind index) — with copy-paste commands, and linked from `README.md` § Documentation.
- `src/recipes/recipe-book.test.ts` enforces **real** CLI-block freshness (regenerate and compare, not just marker presence) and link integrity, and the capstone CLI blocks carry machine-readable markers so they are covered too.
- All related documentation is updated to reflect the changes, including code comments, README, and any relevant wiki or docs site entries.
- Full project test suite must pass with the new changes.

## Constraints

- **Fix the generators, not the pages.** Correct `scripts/recipe-book/*.ts` and
  regenerate `docs/recipe-book/*`; hand-editing generated pages is out of scope.
  Regeneration must remain idempotent (second run byte-identical).
- **No change to recipe content or architecture** — the recipe YAML, roster,
  registry and sound design are untouched.
- **Preserve the book's conventions** — front matter (`title`/`id`/`order`/
  `description`), roster order, tier structure and all existing green gates.
- **UK English** throughout.
- The tier-aware per-page CLI blocks (progressive tooling) are **out of scope**
  and tracked as follow-up **TF-0MV4Z4O8I008IZZX**.

## Existing state

- `docs/recipe-book/` contains `index.md`, `_template.md`, one page per recipe
  (100) and one page per capstone (10).
- `scripts/recipe-book/` contains `generate-index.ts`, `generate-pages.ts`,
  `generate-cli-blocks.ts`, `generate-capstones.ts` and `recipe-meta.ts`.
- `src/recipes/recipe-book.test.ts` gates schema validity, determinism,
  non-silence, page presence, index order, tags and marker presence — but
  **not** block freshness or links.
- `README.md` links the book from § Documentation.
- Verified defects: `../../tonegraph.md` on 101 pages (file is
  `docs/tonegraph.md`); `../../prd/{STACK,SEQUENCER}_PRD.md` on the 10 capstone
  pages (files are `docs/prd/…`); `toneforge show --recipe <name>` on all 100
  recipe pages (command requires a positional name).

## Desired change

- Correct the link targets and the `show` command in the content generators and
  regenerate every page, `_template.md` and `index.md`.
- Add the **Working with the CLI** section to the generated index (find /
  evaluate / understand-creation) and reference it from `README.md`.
- Add machine-readable markers around capstone CLI blocks.
- Strengthen `src/recipes/recipe-book.test.ts`: validate CLI blocks by
  regeneration and add a link-integrity assertion across the book.
- Create and link the follow-up item for tier-aware CLI blocks
  (**TF-0MV4Z4O8I008IZZX**, created).

## Key Files (predicted)

- `scripts/recipe-book/generate-cli-blocks.ts` — fix the invalid `show` command; keep it the single source of block text.
- `scripts/recipe-book/generate-pages.ts` — fix the `show` command and the `../../tonegraph.md` link; reuse the shared block builder.
- `scripts/recipe-book/generate-capstones.ts` — fix `../../prd/…` links; add CLI-block markers.
- `scripts/recipe-book/generate-index.ts` — add the **Working with the CLI** section (idempotent).
- `docs/recipe-book/index.md`, `docs/recipe-book/_template.md`, `docs/recipe-book/*.md` — regenerated output.
- `src/recipes/recipe-book.test.ts` — real CLI freshness + link integrity.
- `README.md` — link the CLI-workflow section / confirm the book entry.

## Risks & assumptions

- **Risk: documentation drift.** The book is generated; a partial fix could be
  overwritten on the next run. *Mitigation:* fix the generators first, regenerate,
  and let the strengthened tests fail on any divergence.
- **Risk: scope creep.** The review will surface further opportunities (e.g.
  tier-aware blocks, richer pages). *Mitigation:* the follow-up is already
  recorded as `TF-0MV4Z4O8I008IZZX`; new ideas become separate `discovered-from`
  items, not this scope.
- **Risk: link-checker false positives** (anchors, absolute URLs, generated
  pages). *Mitigation:* strip `#fragment`s, skip absolute/external URLs, and
  resolve targets relative to each page as the renderer would.
- **Risk: index generation is source-parsed and must stay idempotent.**
  *Mitigation:* add the new section as static generated text and assert a second
  run produces no diff.
- **Assumption:** all remaining `toneforge show`/`list`/`library`/`analyze`/
  `classify`/`explore`/`visualize` commands used in the new section run against
  the current CLI; the implementation validates them.
- **Assumption:** the audience is developers / sound designers working from the
  CLI, and this remains prose documentation (no new demo or web UI).

## Related work (manual)

- `Casual Game Recipe Book: 100 Documented Recipes from Simple to Stings (TF-0MUY9H7QZ000UX5W)` — completed parent epic that produced the book.
- `Tier-aware recipe-book CLI blocks (progressive tooling per tier) (TF-0MV4Z4O8I008IZZX)` — follow-up created by this intake (option B deferred).
- `Sound Module Index — catalogue all modules by primary function (TF-0MV29HYZU001WUW7)` — in-flight docs index; a candidate link for the "how they were created" material.
- `docs/guides/gamedev-workflow-example.md` — precedent CLI discover→inspect→iterate guide.
- `demos/recipe-filtering.md`, `demos/library.md`, `demos/exploration.md`, `demos/classification.md`, `demos/audio-analysis.md`, `demos/machine-use.md` — existing coverage of the individual CLI surfaces.
- `docs/tonegraph.md`, `docs/guides/external-recipes.md` — recipe authoring references.

## Appendix: Clarifying questions & answers

Round 1 asked whether a new document should be created; the producer corrected
the premise — the recipe book already exists and should be reviewed/improved.

- **Q1 (round 1 — document form & location).** New `docs/guides/` guide,
  `docs/recipe-book/README.md`, extend `index.md`, or a `demos/` walkthrough?
  - **Answer (producer, interactive reply):** the book already exists
    (`index.md` + pages); **review and improve that** — do not create a new
    document.
  - Research: confirmed `docs/recipe-book/` holds `index.md`, 100 recipe pages,
    10 capstone pages and `_template.md`, generated by `scripts/recipe-book/*.ts`.
- **Q2 (round 1 — coverage).** How much of the CLI (find / evaluate / understand
  creation / capstones) should be covered?
  - **Answer (producer, interactive reply):** folded into the improve-the-book
    direction; round 2 fixed the scope.
- **Q3 (round 1 — drift protection).** Should documented commands/links be
  machine-verified?
  - **Answer (producer, interactive reply):** yes — carried into round 2 option A.
- **Q4 (round 2 — improvement scope).** (A) fix defects + add CLI-workflow
  section to the index + strengthen tests; (B) A plus tier-aware per-page CLI
  blocks; (C) defects only.
  - **Answer (producer, interactive reply):** **A**, **with a follow-up item for
    B**. Evidence: created `TF-0MV4Z4O8I008IZZX`.
- **Q5 (round 2 — placement of the CLI-workflow content).** Extend
  `docs/recipe-book/index.md`; new `docs/recipe-book/README.md`; or
  `docs/guides/` linked from the index.
  - **Answer (producer, interactive reply):** **A — extend
    `docs/recipe-book/index.md`.**

## Related work (automated report)

### Related work items
- **TF-0MLYG5SUM0F6C40K** – Batch Generation Demo Walkthrough (completed)
- **TF-0MLYG50L81AVET0U** – CLI Help and Flag Validation (completed)
- **TF-0MM64O3VT13YE9SG** – Update library demo commentary for embedding-based similarity (completed)

### Repository file matches
- `standups/2026_10_05.md` — matched: cli, create, created, document, documentation (+11 more)
- `CHANGELOG.md` — matched: cli, create, document, documentation, find (+10 more)
- `docs/prd/DEMO_ROADMAP.md` — matched: cli, create, document, etc, evaluate (+10 more)

# Tier-aware recipe-book CLI blocks — Intake Brief

**Work Item:** `TF-0MV4Z4O8I008IZZX` | **Type:** docs | **Priority:** Medium
**Blocks / Blocked-by:** Blocked-by `TF-0MV290BG8003GXXH`

> **Headline:** Make each recipe-book page's `## ToneForge CLI` block
> **tier-aware** so it demonstrates the pipeline stage appropriate to that tier,
> generated from a single shared builder driven by the roster `tier` (and the
> arrangement kind for capstones), with tests that keep every block fresh and
> valid.

## Problem statement

Every one of the 100 recipe pages currently carries the **same** four-command
`## ToneForge CLI` block (`generate` ×2, `show`, `list recipes`) regardless of
tier, so the book does not teach the ToneForge pipeline progressively. The
seven tiers were designed to illustrate distinct tooling stages
(`analyze`, `classify`/`explore`, `sequence`/`library`, `visualize`,
`stack`) but the pages do not surface them. The block text is also duplicated
in `generate-cli-blocks.ts` and `generate-pages.ts`, and is only checked for
marker *presence* — not freshness — so it cannot stay honest as tiers evolve.

## Users

- **Game developers** working the book front-to-back who learn the tooling in
  the same order as the recipes: each page should show the CLI surface that
  produced or evaluates that tier.
- **Sound designers / technical artists** who want the commands on a page to be
  runnable and to demonstrate the relevant stage (e.g. `classify` for a
  textured recipe, `stack` for a multi-voice sting).
- **ToneForge maintainers** who need the blocks to come from one source of truth
  and the test suite to fail when a page drifts from the generator.

Example user stories:

- As a developer reading Tier 3, I want the page to show `classify` and
  `explore`, so I can see how the tooling evaluates a textured sound.
- As a maintainer, I want one shared block builder, so I cannot introduce a
  third copy of the command text.
- As a maintainer, I want the tests to compare each page's block against the
  generator, so a stale block fails CI.

## Acceptance Criteria

- **Tier-aware blocks.** Every one of the 100 recipe pages' `## ToneForge CLI`
  block contains the command surfaces required for its roster `tier`, per the
  mapping below, and **no** recipe page still carries the previous generic
  four-command block. Each block replaces the generic commands rather than
  appending to them.

  | Tier | Required command surfaces | Example commands (illustrative) |
  |------|---------------------------|----------------------------------|
  | 1 — Pure tones & blips | `generate`, `show`, `list recipes` | `toneforge generate --recipe <name> --seed 42 --output <name>.wav`; `toneforge show <name>`; `toneforge list recipes --tags casual` |
  | 2 — Shaped events | `generate`, `analyze` | `toneforge generate --recipe <name> --seed 42 --output <name>.wav`; `toneforge analyze --recipe <name> --seed 42` |
  | 3 — Textured & filtered | `classify`, `explore` | `toneforge classify --recipe <name> --seed 42`; `toneforge explore sweep --recipe <name> --seed-range 1:50 --keep-top 5` |
  | 4 — Melodic motifs | `sequence`, `library` | `toneforge sequence inspect --preset presets/sequences/casual_level_complete_sequence.json`; `toneforge library list` |
  | 5 — Character & critter voices | `classify`, `visualize` | `toneforge classify --recipe <name> --seed 42`; `toneforge visualize export --recipe <name> --seed 42 --format frames` |
  | 6 — Ambience & loops | `sequence`, `explore` | `toneforge sequence inspect --preset presets/sequences/footsteps_run.json`; `toneforge explore sweep --recipe <name> --seed-range 1:50 --keep-top 5` |
  | 7 — Multi-voice stings | `stack`, `visualize` | `toneforge stack inspect --preset presets/stacks/casual_victory_stack.json`; `toneforge visualize export --recipe <name> --seed 42 --format frames` |

- **Single shared builder + idempotence.** One shared block renderer, driven by
  the roster `tier` for recipe pages and by the arrangement kind for capstones,
  is the only source of block text used by `generate-cli-blocks.ts`,
  `generate-pages.ts` and `generate-capstones.ts`. Running the generators twice
  produces byte-identical `docs/recipe-book/*.md` (idempotent regeneration).

- **Valid commands and references.** Every command in a block uses a current,
  valid ToneForge subcommand/flag; every `--recipe <name>` resolves to the
  page's recipe (or another registered recipe); and every `--preset <path>`
  resolves to an existing file under `presets/`. Capstone `## ToneForge CLI`
  blocks are wrapped in machine-readable
  `<!-- CLI_BLOCK_START … -->`/`<!-- CLI_BLOCK_END -->` markers.

- **Tests enforce freshness (testing/validation).**
  `src/recipes/recipe-book.test.ts` validates each recipe page's block by
  comparing it to the shared builder output (not marker presence), asserts each
  tier's block contains exactly its required surfaces, asserts capstone block
  markers exist and are fresh, and asserts every `--preset` reference exists.
  A drifted committed page fails the suite.

- All related documentation is updated to reflect the changes, including code
  comments, README, and any relevant wiki or docs site entries.

- Full project test suite must pass with the new changes.

## Constraints

- **Fix the generators, not the pages.** Change `scripts/recipe-book/*.ts` and
  regenerate `docs/recipe-book/*`; hand-editing generated pages is out of scope.
- **Single source of truth.** Do not add a second/third copy of block text;
  reuse (or create) the shared builder. Build on the shared builder, corrected
  `toneforge show <name>` positional command, capstone markers and freshness
  test delivered by `TF-0MV290BG8003GXXH` rather than duplicating them.
- **Sequenced after the parent.** This item is **blocked-by**
  `TF-0MV290BG8003GXXH` (same generator files, overlapping capstone-marker
  scope) and does not block it.
- **No change to recipe content or architecture.** Recipe YAML, roster,
  registry, parameter tables and sound-design narratives are untouched.
- **Preserve book conventions** — front matter (`title`/`id`/`order`/
  `description`), roster order, tier structure and all existing green gates.
- **UK English** throughout.
- `sequence`/`stack` commands require `--preset` (no `--recipe`), so T4/T6/T7
  reference a fixed, existing representative preset; pick one that is topically
  representative and keep the reference stable.

## Existing state

- `scripts/recipe-book/generate-cli-blocks.ts` — standalone generate/validate
  script; emits the fixed four commands.
- `scripts/recipe-book/generate-pages.ts` — `generateCliBlock(name)` duplicate
  used when rendering the 100 recipe pages.
- `scripts/recipe-book/generate-capstones.ts` — already emits **kind-aware**
  stack/sequence commands (`stack inspect|render`, `sequence inspect|generate`,
  `list stacks|sequences`) but with **no** CLI-block markers.
- `src/recipes/recipe-book.test.ts` — `expectCliBlockFresh()` only asserts that
  `<!-- CLI_BLOCK_START` / `<!-- CLI_BLOCK_END -->` exist on recipe pages.
- The per-tier tooling intent is already documented in the seven tier work
  items' ACs (epic `TF-0MUY9H7QZ000UX5W`).

## Desired change

- Extract a pure shared builder (e.g. `scripts/recipe-book/cli-blocks.ts`) that
  maps a recipe's `tier` to its command list and renders the marker-wrapped
  block, and make `generate-cli-blocks.ts`, `generate-pages.ts` and
  `generate-capstones.ts` all use it.
- Make the recipe-page block tier-aware per the mapping above; keep capstone
  blocks arrangement-kind-aware and wrap them in markers.
- Regenerate every recipe and capstone page.
- Strengthen `src/recipes/recipe-book.test.ts` with real freshness, per-tier
  surface, capstone-marker and preset-existence assertions.

## Key Files (predicted)

- `scripts/recipe-book/generate-cli-blocks.ts` — host (or delegate to) the
  tier→surface mapping and shared renderer; keep the `--validate` path.
- `scripts/recipe-book/generate-pages.ts` — remove the duplicated
  `generateCliBlock()`; call the shared tier-aware builder.
- `scripts/recipe-book/generate-capstones.ts` — render capstone blocks via the
  shared builder; wrap in markers; validate freshness.
- `scripts/recipe-book/cli-blocks.ts` (new, if the parent has not already
  introduced a shared module) — pure, side-effect-free `renderCliBlock(name,
  tier)` / kind-aware renderer importable by scripts **and** tests.
- `docs/recipe-book/*.md` — regenerated output (100 recipe pages + 10 capstone
  pages).
- `src/recipes/recipe-book.test.ts` — tier-aware freshness/surface/preset tests.
- `docs/recipe-book/index.md`, `README.md` — only if the tier→tooling mapping
  needs documenting for readers.

## Related work (manual)

- `Tier-aware recipe-book CLI blocks (progressive tooling per tier) (TF-0MV4Z4O8I008IZZX)` — this item, deferred out of the parent review.
- `Review the 100 sound library documentation (TF-0MV290BG8003GXXH)` — **blocking** parent: fixes the `show` command, adds the shared builder, capstone markers and freshness test.
- `Casual Game Recipe Book: 100 Documented Recipes from Simple to Stings (TF-0MUY9H7QZ000UX5W)` — completed epic that produced the book.
- Tier 1–7 work items (`TF-0MUYBDMHM003TI3D`, `TF-0MUYBDMUK0017P9H`, `TF-0MUYBDN7U002PDCQ`, `TF-0MUYBDNKI001IHW4`, `TF-0MUYBDNXI003BNUF`, `TF-0MUYBDOAE006OK3D`, `TF-0MUYBDONM008UGQW`) — source of the per-tier tooling mapping.
- `Capstone Arrangements (TF-0MUYBDP0L001QIVX)` — capstone stack/sequence presets and pages.
- `Fix recipe-book gate vacuity and index ordering (TF-0MUYJT9PP004JMV7)` — precedents for strengthening recipe-book tests.
- `scripts/recipe-book/generate-cli-blocks.ts`, `scripts/recipe-book/generate-pages.ts`, `scripts/recipe-book/generate-capstones.ts`, `src/recipes/recipe-book.test.ts` — the files to change.

## Related work (automated report)

### Related work items
- **TF-0MM79EVKX0TSVWQC** – Collection & Economy Recipes (Tier 3) (completed)
- **TF-0MV29HYZU001WUW7** – Sound Module Index — catalogue all modules by primary function (completed)
- **TF-0MM0BWFC515OBCEO** – CLI UX & Commands (completed)

### Repository file matches
- `standups/2026_10_05.md` — matched: add, analyze, appropriate, around, aware (+44 more)
- `docs/prd/DEMO_ROADMAP.md` — matched: add, analyze, appropriate, around, aware (+38 more)
- `README.md` — matched: add, analyze, aware, block, book (+32 more)

## Risks & assumptions

- **Risk: command drift.** A documented example command may stop matching the
  CLI. *Mitigation:* assert valid surfaces and that every referenced
  `--preset`/`--recipe` target exists; run a smoke check during implementation.
- **Risk: brittle tests.** Exact-line equality across 110 pages could make
  future recipe edits noisy. *Mitigation:* the freshness test compares against
  the shared builder (single source of truth), while tier assertions check
  command *surfaces* rather than full lines.
- **Risk: duplicated capstone-marker work.** The parent already adds capstone
  markers. *Mitigation:* this item is blocked-by the parent and extends marker
  coverage to freshness validation rather than re-adding markers.
- **Risk: scope creep** (richer per-page narrative, more tier-specific flags).
  *Mitigation:* record further ideas as `discovered-from:TF-0MV4Z4O8I008IZZX`
  items, not in this scope.
- **Assumption:** `TF-0MV290BG8003GXXH` lands first, providing the shared
  builder, the positional `toneforge show <name>` command, capstone markers and
  the freshness test this item builds on.
- **Assumption:** T4/T6/T7 use fixed representative presets
  (`casual_level_complete_sequence.json`, `footsteps_run.json`,
  `casual_victory_stack.json`) because `sequence`/`stack` require `--preset`;
  the implementer may substitute a topically closer existing preset.
- **Assumption:** freshness is validated by importing a pure shared builder in
  the test (no side-effecting generator subprocess).

## Appendix: Clarifying questions & answers

Round 1 (producer, interactive reply) confirmed the per-tier command mapping,
block composition and sequencing against the parent item.

- **Q1 (round 1 — exact commands for T4/T6/T7).** The tier ACs name only
  "`sequence` (light) and `library`" (T4), "`sequence` and `explore`" (T6) and
  "`stack` concepts and `visualize`" (T7); these recipes are neither sequences
  nor stacks, so the exact commands were ambiguous. Options: A. concrete
  commands on the recipe where supported, otherwise a representative preset;
  B. always the specific capstone that uses the recipe (recipe→capstone
  lookup); C. one command per tier; D. freeform.
  - **Answer (producer, interactive reply): A.** Use concrete commands on the
    recipe where the surface supports `--recipe` (`classify`, `explore`,
    `visualize`, `analyze`), and a fixed representative `--preset` for the
    `sequence`/`stack` surfaces. Evidence: tier work items' ACs; CLI option
    inspection (`sequence`/`stack` accept only `--preset`).
- **Q2 (round 1 — block composition).** A. replace the generic four commands
  entirely; B. keep a `generate`+`show` baseline then append; C. replace but
  keep `generate`.
  - **Answer (producer, interactive reply): A.** Replace entirely, matching the
    item's stated intent ("instead of repeating the same four commands"); the
    central discovery workflow is covered by the index's *Working with the CLI*
    section.
- **Q3 (round 1 — sequencing vs the parent).** Should this item be
  blocked-by `TF-0MV290BG8003GXXH`, which edits the same generators and already
  adds capstone markers? A. yes; B. keep independent.
  - **Answer (producer, interactive reply): A.** Record `Blocked-by:
    TF-0MV290BG8003GXXH` to serialise overlapping generator edits. Evidence:
    parent's Key Files and desired change.

## Goal

As a ToneForge maintainer I want every local relative link in the recipe book to resolve, and a test that fails when one breaks, so the book cannot silently drift into 404s.

**Parent:** TF-0MV290BG8003GXXH — Review the 100 sound library documentation. This is slice 1 of 5 (vertical slices: links → CLI blocks → capstone markers → CLI-workflow section → verification).

## Target outcome

`docs/recipe-book/` contains zero broken local relative links (currently 121 broken links across 111 pages), enforced by a link-integrity test that covers `index.md`, `_template.md`, the 100 recipe pages and the 10 capstone pages.

## Definition of done

- The generated `## See also` links target real files: `../../tonegraph.md` → `../tonegraph.md` (101 pages, including `_template.md`) and `../../prd/STACK_PRD.md` / `../../prd/SEQUENCER_PRD.md` → `../prd/…` (10 capstone pages).
- The corrections live in the generators (`scripts/recipe-book/generate-pages.ts`, `scripts/recipe-book/generate-capstones.ts`); `_template.md` is hand-maintained — no script emits it — so it is edited directly and that is recorded in a code comment.
- Affected pages are regenerated and a second regeneration is byte-identical.
- A link-integrity test in `src/recipes/recipe-book.test.ts` resolves every inline link relative to its page and fails with the offending page + target.
- `npx vitest run src/recipes/recipe-book.test.ts` passes.

## Constraints

- Fix the generators and regenerate; do not hand-edit generated pages. `_template.md` is the only direct page edit (it has no generator).
- No changes to recipe YAML, roster, registry or sound design.
- Preserve front matter, roster order, tier structure and every existing green gate; UK English throughout.

## Risky assumptions

- The book uses only inline `[text](target)` links. Mitigation: the test asserts the number of parsed links, so reference-style links cannot slip through unparsed.
- Anchor-only links (`#section`), absolute URLs and external hosts are out of scope for resolution.

## Acceptance Criteria

- All local relative links in `docs/recipe-book/` resolve: a link-integrity check (new or extended) passes for `index.md`, `_template.md`, all 100 recipe pages and all 10 capstone pages, with zero broken local targets.
- `../../tonegraph.md` no longer appears in any recipe-book page and `../../prd/` no longer appears in any capstone page; the generator sources are corrected so regeneration reproduces the correct links.
- `src/recipes/recipe-book.test.ts` resolves every inline link relative to its page, skips `#fragment`s, absolute URLs and external hosts, and reports the offending page and target on failure.
- Regenerating with `tsx scripts/recipe-book/generate-pages.ts` and `tsx scripts/recipe-book/generate-capstones.ts` twice produces byte-identical output, leaving `git status --porcelain docs/recipe-book` clean.
- The recipe-book test file passes.

## Key Files

- `scripts/recipe-book/generate-pages.ts` — fix the `../../tonegraph.md` target.
- `scripts/recipe-book/generate-capstones.ts` — fix the `../../prd/…` targets.
- `docs/recipe-book/_template.md` — hand-maintained template; fix the `../../tonegraph.md` target.
- `docs/recipe-book/index.md` — index plus the 100 recipe and 10 capstone pages as regenerated output.
- `src/recipes/recipe-book.test.ts` — link-integrity gate.

## Dependencies

None — this is the first slice and unblocks the CLI-block slices.

## Deliverables

Correct link targets in the generators and the template, regenerated pages, and a link-integrity gate in the recipe-book test battery.
